description: List the entries Finn flagged for a second look before they reach a VAT return: suspect or duplicate receipts and invoices, VAT added to a zero-rated purchase, VAT that does not fit the total, personal-looking purchases and amounts out of line with a supplier. Use when the user asks about flagged, suspect, duplicate or odd entries, or when get_attention shows entries needing a second look. Each flag has entity_type, entity_id, label, severity, title and detail.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.
